notes.title: Fateless Night is out now!
notes.content:
Heya, guys! 

I'm excited to announce that Fateless Night is finally released on Steam! It has been a long and challenging journey from the perspective of a solo developer— the game was changed multiple times and was constantly updated with new ideas. While I couldn't bring all my ideas to life, I am still very satisfied with the result. And I hope you will enjoy this game as well.
